title: Lettuce Dataset with RGB Canopy Images, Biomass, Nutrient Solution, and Environmental Variables for Machine Learning Model Development

archive.acquisition: Selected original ZIP members by HTTP byte ranges; entry CRC verified.

files.acquisition_note: Retained unchanged in earlier same-run optional figure range acquisition; not training input.
Retained unchanged in earlier same-run optional figure range acquisition; not training input.

changes: Original selected files unchanged; tabular normalization described separately.
independence: One shared NFT lettuce cultivation cycle; plants and repeated days are not independent cultivation cycles.
limitations: No spaceflight or ASTRA-BIO tray observations.
No randomized water/light/temperature stress intervention is documented in this dataset.
Fresh biomass basis must be preserved; never reinterpret it as edible yield.

normalization.cultivar_handling: Source specifies butterhead lettuce, not a named cultivar; unspecified_butterhead preserves this uncertainty.
normalization.mass_basis_handling: Source describes non-destructive fresh biomass weighing; plant part is unspecified, so mass_basis=unspecified_fresh. Not edible yield.

calendar_conflict.handling: Preserve source Excel dates without silently correcting the year; fit only the explicit DAT column. One source cycle is retained without assuming a calendar year.

normalization.normalization: Unpivot original individual biomass cells from B2/B3/B4 sheets; exclude Sum columns and blank day31harvest mass. No interpolation, imputation, synthetic mass, or resource-response target generation.
